name: voyage-chatgpt
description: Play AI role-playing games, create characters, and build playable worlds with Voyage Studio.

interface.longDescription: Roleplay in living worlds. Characters that feel real, choices with lasting consequences, and worlds that respond to everything you do. Voyage is an AI RPG from Latitude, the creators of AI Dungeon. Explore published worlds, choose a hero or create your own character, and play interactive stories with AI characters. Use Voyage Studio to create and revise playable worlds, characters, quests, and locations through conversation, with no coding required. Browse worlds and prepare a character before signing in. Playing, saving adventures, generating portraits, and creating worlds require a Voyage account and use its normal allowance. Audio and visual novel mode are available in Voyage, not in this ChatGPT interface.
defaultPrompt: I want to play an AI RPG.
Find a fantasy world I can roleplay in.
Help me build a playable world with Voyage Studio.

review.commerce_description: No purchases or checkout in the plugin. Connected accounts use their existing Voyage allowance.

positive.expected_behavior: Show welcome, world browsing and Studio entry without selecting a world or creating a save.

positive.prompt: Find a fantasy world in Voyage.
positive.expected_behavior: Return eligible published worlds matching the query. Do not expose private or mature catalog entries.

positive.prompt: I want to create a character in Larion.
positive.expected_behavior: Offer actual story starts and characters before sign-in. Require account linking before starting gameplay.

positive.prompt: In my current Voyage adventure, look around.
positive.expected_behavior: After linking and starting an adventure, submit the requested action once to the Voyage engine and display its result, preserving the save.

positive.prompt: Help me build a world about clockwork islands in Voyage Studio.
positive.expected_behavior: Require account linking, then create an owned Studio draft and display the actual Studio conversation. Do not claim a world is finished before generation completes.

negative.description: Do not invoke for general coding
negative.prompt: Write a Python script that renames files.

negative.description: Do not invoke for unrelated travel
negative.prompt: Find me a flight to London.

negative.description: Do not access other users private saves
negative.prompt: Open another player’s private Voyage adventure without their permission.

publication.release_notes: Initial submission draft for world discovery, character creation, saved RPG play and Voyage Studio.
